policy.identity: Match paths case-insensitively; retain catalog spelling. Record asset GUIDs in collection results.
policy.purpose: Evidence IDs identify the research purpose and source report for each asset.
policy.dependencies: Dependencies are direct external EBX references seen in existing XML, not confirmed active gameplay branches. Scan collected dependencies recursively; record cycles, missing assets and unresolved GUID-only references. Coverage is incomplete until that traversal finishes.
policy.referenceOnlyTargets: Dependency paths not present as asset entries are candidates to collect and inspect, not silently resolved dependencies. Default to raw-ebx and xml, except material grids: raw-ebx only.
policy.discovery: Compare the full catalog each build. Review discovery candidates before adding them to required collection.
policy.formats: XML is a decoded view. Keep raw EBX plus matching descriptors. Localization may need separate string/RES/chunk extraction; EBX alone does not preserve those payloads.
policy.snapshot: Do not overwrite old snapshots. Keep raw assets, XML, descriptors and tool versions together. Do not include recordings.
policy.lastVerifiedBuild: Not assigned per asset during seeding; source reports and local XML may have mixed provenance. Record verified build identity in actual collection results.
policy.pendingEvidence: Claude research reports from 6-14 SEP 2026 were merged with scripts/frosty-watchlist-merge.py. This is still not an inventory of all research; add new reports there.
